$comment: Machine-readable contract for the Gatepath audit log, schema version 2. Both platforms load this file in their test suites and assert their writer's output conforms. Readers must map v1_key_renames when decoding a schema_version 1 line so old lines keep their counts. Human-readable docs live in AUDIT_LOG_SCHEMA.md.
optional_fields_comment: Fields added after schema_version 1 was already in the wild. Writers on both platforms MUST emit them; readers MUST tolerate their absence, because log lines written before the field existed are still valid v1. Adding a field here is NOT a breaking change and does NOT bump schema_version — removing one, or changing a required field, would.

observed_resource_requests.android: Count of resource sub-requests that matched a tracker domain. Observed via WebViewClient.shouldInterceptRequest; counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
observed_resource_requests.desktop: Count of tracker-domain subresource requests the WebView observed. Counted, allowed to load. Carried from the portal subprocess via the observation channel (portal_observations); 0 when that file is missing or unreadable. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.

observed_navigation_attempts.android: Count of off-domain navigations the WebView observed (not in the portal host's same-origin set). Counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
observed_navigation_attempts.desktop: Count of off-domain navigations the WebView observed. Counted, allowed to load. Carried from the portal subprocess via the observation channel (portal_observations); 0 when that file is missing or unreadable. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.

tls_cert_errors_bypassed.android: Count of TLS certificate errors the WebView was told to proceed past (WebViewClient.onReceivedSslError -> handler.proceed()). Only ever incremented for the portal host and its subdomains; cert errors on any other host are cancelled and NOT counted here. A non-zero value means the session rendered a page whose certificate did not validate. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
tls_cert_errors_bypassed.desktop: Count of TLS certificate errors proceeded past on the portal host (load-failed-with-tls-errors, gated by ssl_error_policy — same host-scoped rule as Android). Off-domain certificate errors are refused and NOT counted here. A non-zero value means the session rendered a page whose certificate did not validate. The portal WebView runs in a subprocess, so the count reaches this entry through the observation channel (portal_observations); if that file is missing or unreadable the field is 0, since losing a count must not cost the session record.

confinement.android: 'confined' only for a session opened from a classified Confined state, which requires the Wi-Fi-bound probe to have reached the gateway — netd permits that only when no secure VPN covers Gatepath (or Gatepath is excluded from it). The debug-force path opens a session without classifying and writes 'unconfined'. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
confinement.desktop: 'confined' when the netns helper launched the portal WebView inside the gatepath namespace; 'unconfined' for the in-process (Flatpak-only) path, where WebKitGTK traffic follows the system default route.
